async def act(page):
    # Fill the product name
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Name *").fill("FancyBoy Man Causal Jeans")
    # Click on the 'Prices' link to navigate to the price section
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Prices").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Assuming price field is present, fill it with $169.99
    # The accessibility tree doesn't show the price field, but based on typical Magento, it should be a textbox with name 'Price' or similar.
    # I'll use a generic selector; in practice, this might need adjustment.
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Price").fill("169.99")
    # Click on the 'Inventory' link to set stock
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Inventory").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Fill stock quantity with 42
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Qty").fill("42")
    # Navigate back to 'General' or appropriate section for size and color
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="General").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Set size 34 and color Blue. These might be comboboxes or text fields.
    # Since not specified in tree, I'll assume they are comboboxes and use select_option.
    # For size: combobox with name 'Size'
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option("34")
    # For color: combobox with name 'Color'
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Color").select_option("Blue")
    # Save the product
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
